<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

/* ===== 小手机外壳 ===== */
.ios-device{
  position:relative;width:260px;height:520px;
  border-radius:36px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #e8e8ec 0%, #a0a0a8 50%, #1a1a1e 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #2a2a2c,0 0 0 5px #1a1a1a,0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  overflow:hidden;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
}

.ios-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px 2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;position:relative;z-index:3}
.dynamic-island{width:78px;height:22px;background:#000;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #111}
.status-icons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:9px}
.batt{display:inline-flex;width:20px;height:9px;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:2px;padding:1px;position:relative}
.batt::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-3px;top:2px;width:2px;height:4px;background:#fff;border-radius:0 1px 1px 0}
.batt i{display:block;width:75%;height:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:1px}

.date-widget{text-align:center;padding:6px 0 4px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);position:relative;z-index:3}
.date-widget .date{font-size:11px;opacity:.95;letter-spacing:.5px}
.date-widget .bigtime{font-size:36px;font-weight:200;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-top:2px}

/* App 网格 */
.app-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px 10px;padding:12px 30px 0;position:relative;z-index:3}
.app-wrapper{text-align:center;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.app-icon{
  width:48px;height:48px;margin:0 auto 4px;border-radius:12px;
  display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  font-size:0;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  transition:transform .15s;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
}
.app-wrapper:active .app-icon{transform:scale(.9)}
.app-name{font-size:10px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6);font-weight:500}

/* 🌟 真实图标URL */
.ic-profile{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/ae9d6ae41551bc87497eb876eb982416.png")}
.ic-wechat{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/a096d7e1c421721fd8e980187c40d84a.png")}
.ic-alipay{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/de5497dc0848f31f26be35672319864f.png")}
.ic-qzone{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/b069bf9740629760b829143ba071f6c0.png")}
.ic-notes{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/67bbf614b60cf002133b097067515243.png")}
.ic-reminder{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/2295d425bf7944314437493643241e33.png")}
.ic-safari{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/7bc99f40c09010194ac572a85748b4ec.png")}
.ic-meituan{background-image:url("https://nos.netease.com/ysf/7bc0b6261bccd244cb8997836428b407.png")}

/* Home 指示条 */
.home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:100px;height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:3px;z-index:200;cursor:pointer}

/* App 弹窗 */
.app-window{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#f2f2f7;z-index:50;transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#1c1c1e;text-align:left;border-radius:36px;overflow:hidden}
.app-window.open{transform:translateY(0)}
.window-top{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 14px 8px;background:rgba(242,242,247,.95);border-bottom:.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.back-btn{color:#007aff;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;min-width:44px}
.back-btn::before{content:"‹ ";font-weight:300;font-size:15px}
.window-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.window-top-right{min-width:44px}
.window-content{padding:12px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;padding-bottom:40px}
.window-content::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

/* ========== 资料页 ========== */
.qq-banner{height:60px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2)}
.qq-card{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px 10px;margin-top:-26px;background:#fff;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;position:relative;margin-bottom:10px}
.qq-avatar{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd1e8,#c8b6ff);border:2px solid #fff;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:-18px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.qq-info{flex:1;min-width:0;padding-top:8px}
.qq-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qq-status-dot{font-size:8px;color:#34c759;background:#e8f8ec;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:500}
.qq-id{font-size:9px;color:#8e8e93;margin-top:2px}
.qq-vip{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qq-vip span{font-size:8px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
.qq-coin{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffe082,#ffb74d);color:#6d4c00}
.qq-vip-tag{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9a9e,#fad0c4);color:#b71c1c}
.qq-level{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a18cd1,#fbc2eb);color:#4a148c}
.qq-like{text-align:center;font-size:14px;padding-top:10px}
.qq-like span{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#8e8e93;margin-top:2px}
.qq-meta{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 10px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5;margin-bottom:12px}
.qq-meta-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 0;font-size:11px}
.m-l{color:#8e8e93}
.m-v{color:#1c1c1e;font-weight:500;max-width:60%;text-align:right}

/* 资料页 - 屏幕使用时间 */
.st-widget{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5;margin-bottom:10px}
.st-header{font-size:12px;color:#8e8e93;margin-bottom:4px}
.st-date{font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;margin-bottom:2px}
.st-total-time{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e;margin-bottom:15px;letter-spacing:-0.5px}
.st-list-header{font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:.5px solid #f0f0f5}
.st-list-header span{color:#007aff;font-size:11px}
.st-app-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.st-app-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.st-app-icon-st{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:#f2f2f7;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.st-app-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.st-app-name{font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:500}
.st-app-bar-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.st-app-bar-bg{flex:1;height:5px;background:#f0f0f5;border-radius:2.5px;overflow:hidden}
.st-app-bar-fill{height:100%;background:#007aff;border-radius:2.5px}
.st-app-time{font-size:10px;color:#8e8e93;min-width:45px;text-align:right}

/* ========== 微信 ========== */
.chat-card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.card-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:#f8f8f8;border-bottom:0.5px solid #e5e5ea}
.card-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#1c1c1e}
.card-body{padding:10px}
.wc-bg .wc-row{margin-bottom:8px}
.wc-bg .wc-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.wc-bg{background:#ededed;margin:-12px;padding:12px;min-height:100%}
.wc-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.wc-row.right{justify-content:flex-end}
.wc-av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd1e8,#c8b6ff);flex-shrink:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center}

.wc-bubble{max-width:70%;padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;border-radius:5px;position:relative;word-break:break-word}
.bubble-l{background:#fff;color:#1c1c1e}
.bubble-l::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-5px;top:10px;border:5px solid transparent;border-right-color:#fff}
.bubble-r{background:#95ec69;color:#000}
.bubble-r::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5px;top:10px;border:5px solid transparent;border-left-color:#95ec69}

/* ========== 支付宝 ========== */
.al-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1677ff,#3a8aff);color:#fff;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.al-hero .lbl{font-size:10px;opacity:.85}
.al-hero .num{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:3px}
.al-list{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #f0f0f5;margin-bottom:8px}
.al-item{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;gap:8px;border-bottom:.5px solid #f0f0f5}
.al-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.al-ico{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0}
.al-i1{background:#fff3e0}.al-i2{background:#fce4ec}.al-i3{background:#e8eaf6}
.al-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.al-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.al-desc{font-size:9px;color:#8e8e93;margin-top:1px}
.al-amt{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.al-summary{background:#f7f9fc;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px dashed #d0dae5}
.al-sum-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:3px 0;font-size:11px}
.al-sum-out{color:#ff3b30;font-weight:700}
.al-final{padding-top:6px;border-top:.5px solid #e0e7ef;margin-top:3px}
.al-sum-final{color:#1677ff;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}

/* ========== Twitter风格 QQ空间 ========== */
.tw-item{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5}
.tw-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.tw-av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd1e8,#c8b6ff);background-size:cover;background-position:center;flex-shrink:0}
.tw-meta{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tw-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#0f1419}
.tw-handle{font-weight:400;color:#536471;font-size:10px}
.tw-more{color:#536471;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.tw-text{font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#0f1419;margin-bottom:8px;padding-left:42px;margin-left:-8px;padding-right:0;word-break:break-word}
.tw-actions{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;color:#536471;padding:6px 0 4px;border-top:.5px solid #eff3f4;border-bottom:.5px solid #eff3f4}
.tw-actions span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.tw-replies{padding-top:6px}
.tw-reply{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:.5px solid #f5f5f9}
.tw-reply:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.tw-rav{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a8edea,#fed6e3);flex-shrink:0;font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.tw-rbody{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tw-rname{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#0f1419}
.tw-rtext{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#0f1419;margin-top:1px;word-break:break-word}

/* ========== 备忘录 ========== */
.memo-it{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5;position:relative}
.memo-it-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e;margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.3}
.memo-it-date{font-size:9px;color:#8e8e93;text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.memo-it-body{font-size:11px;color:#3c3c43;line-height:1.65;word-break:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap}

/* ========== 提醒事项 ========== */
.rm-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff9500,#ffb340);color:#fff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.rm-hero .lbl{font-size:10px;opacity:.9}
.rm-hero .count{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.rm-list{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #f0f0f5}
.rm-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:.5px solid #f0f0f5}
.rm-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.rm-circle{width:14px;height:14px;border:1.5px solid #c7c7cc;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px}
.rm-circle.imp{border-color:#ff9500;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ff9500 30%,transparent 32%)}
.rm-title{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
.rm-flag{font-size:9px;color:#ff9500;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
/* ===== 行程提醒 / Wallet机票 ===== */
.rm-travel-section{
  margin-top:12px;
}

.rm-travel-title{
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#1c1c1e;
  margin:10px 4px 8px;
}

.rm-taxi-card{
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid #f0f0f5;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:10px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}

.rm-taxi-head{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}

.rm-taxi-main{
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#1c1c1e;
}

.rm-taxi-sub{
  font-size:10px;
  color:#8e8e93;
  margin-top:2px;
}

.rm-chip{
  font-size:10px;
  background:#f2f2f7;
  padding:2px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  white-space:nowrap;
  color:#333;
}

.rm-row{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:11px;
  padding:2px 0;
  color:#3c3c43;
  line-height:1.45;
}

.rm-price{
  margin-top:6px;
  text-align:right;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#ff3b30;
}

/* Wallet风机票卡 */
.rm-wallet-ticket{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#18233a 0%,#2a4c80 55%,#101827 100%);
  border-radius:18px;
  padding:14px 14px 12px;
  color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(16,24,39,.18);
}

.rm-wallet-ticket::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  left:-9px; 
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  background:#f5f5f5;
  border-radius:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
}



.rm-wallet-ticket::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  right:-9px;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  background:#f5f5f5;
  border-radius:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
}

.rm-wallet-top{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:flex-start;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}

.rm-wallet-airline{
  font-size:11px;
  opacity:.82;
  letter-spacing:.6px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}

.rm-wallet-type{
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.15;
  margin-top:4px;
}

.rm-wallet-name{
  font-size:10px;
  opacity:.92;
  margin-top:4px;
}

.rm-wallet-pill{
  font-size:10px;
  padding:3px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  white-space:nowrap;
}

.rm-wallet-route{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  padding:10px 0 12px;
}

.rm-wallet-city{
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
}

.rm-wallet-k{
  font-size:9px;
  opacity:.72;
  line-height:1;
}

.rm-wallet-cityname{
  font-size:11px;
  opacity:.96;
  margin-top:4px;
  word-break:break-all;
  line-height:1.35;
}

.rm-wallet-path{
  width:90px;
  flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  position:relative;
}

.rm-wallet-line{
  width:100%;
  height:1px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  position:relative;
}

.rm-wallet-line::before,
.rm-wallet-line::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:-3px;
  width:6px;
  height:6px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;
}

.rm-wallet-line::before{left:0;}
.rm-wallet-line::after{right:0;}

.rm-wallet-plane{
  position:absolute;
  font-size:14px;
  transform:translateY(-1px);
}

.rm-wallet-divider{
  border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  margin:2px 0 10px;
}

.rm-wallet-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px 10px;
}

.rm-wallet-kv{
  min-width:0;
}

.rm-wallet-v{
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:600;
  margin-top:3px;
  word-break:break-word;
  line-height:1.35;
}
.rm-wallet-footer{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:flex-end;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:10px;
  padding-top:10px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
}

.rm-wallet-price-label{
  font-size:9px;
  opacity:.72;
}

.rm-wallet-price{
  font-size:20px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1;
}

.rm-wallet-note{
  font-size:9px;
  opacity:.72;
  text-align:right;
}

/* ========== Safari  ========== */
.sf-urlbar{padding:8px 10px;background:#fff;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;border:1px solid #e5e5ea;margin-bottom:12px}
.sf-section{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 0 5px;color:#333}
.sf-list{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #f0f0f5;margin-bottom:14px}
.sf-item{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:.5px solid #f0f0f5;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
.sf-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.sf-wb-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5}
.sf-wb-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.sf-wb-av{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff9a9e,#fecfef);flex-shrink:0}
.sf-wb-info{flex:1}
.sf-wb-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e67e22}
.sf-wb-meta{font-size:9px;color:#999}
.sf-wb-content{font-size:11px;color:#333;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;word-break:break-word}
.sf-wb-comment{background:#f7f7fa;padding:8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;color:#555}
.sf-wb-comment-name{color:#1677ff;font-weight:600;margin-right:5px}

/* ========== 美团外卖 ========== */
.mt-order{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #f0f0f5}
.mt-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #f5f5f5;padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.mt-status{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:#333}
.mt-shop{font-size:11px;color:#666}
.mt-section-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;color:#333}
.mt-info-row{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-bottom:6px;line-height:1.4}
.mt-info-label{width:48px;flex-shrink:0;color:#999}
.mt-goods{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#fcfcfc;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.mt-goods-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#333}
.mt-goods-price{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#333}

  data-g2_name="{{1.g2_name}}" data-g2_price="{{1.g2_price}}" data-g2_icon="{{1.g2_icon}}"
  data-g3_name="{{1.g3_name}}" data-g3_price="{{1.g3_price}}" data-g3_icon="{{1.g3_icon}}"
  data-g4_name="{{1.g4_name}}" data-g4_price="{{1.g4_price}}" data-g4_icon="{{1.g4_icon}}"
  data-g5_name="{{1.g5_name}}" data-g5_price="{{1.g5_price}}" data-g5_icon="{{1.g5_icon}}"
  data-g6_name="{{1.g6_name}}" data-g6_price="{{1.g6_price}}" data-g6_icon="{{1.g6_icon}}"

></div>

<div id="pokePhrases" style="display:none"
  data-p0="别戳了，再戳我就告诉{{char}}你偷懒！"
  data-p1="{{char}}说你再戳我他就亲自来收拾你~"
  data-p2="哎呀！你戳到我的痒痒肉了！"
  data-p3="你再戳？{{char}}正在看着你呢👀"
  data-p4="呜呜呜我要告诉{{char}}你欺负我！"
  data-p5="戳一下=欠{{char}}一次惩罚，你自己算吧"
  data-p6="{{char}}刚才问我谁在戳你，我说不知道…"
  data-p7="好痛！{{char}}快来救我！"
></div>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  function $(s){ return document.querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s){ return document.querySelectorAll(s); }

  function esc(s){
    return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,''');
  }

  (function(){
    var n = new Date();
    document.getElementById('t').textContent = String(n.getHours()).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    var bat = Math.floor(70 + Math.random() * 30);
    var batEl = document.getElementById('bat');
    batEl.textContent = bat;
    if(bat <= 20) batEl.style.color = '#ff3c00';
  })();

  var isNight = false;
  var skinBtn = document.getElementById('skinBtn');
  skinBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    isNight = !isNight;
    var phone = document.getElementById('phone');
    if(isNight){ phone.classList.add('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '☀️'; }
    else { phone.classList.remove('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '🌙'; }
  });

  function getData(){
    var dataEl = document.getElementById('tbData');
    var raw = (dataEl && dataEl.dataset) ? dataEl.dataset : {};
    function v(k, def){
      var s = raw[k];
      if(s === undefined || s === null) return def;
      s = String(s).trim();
      if(!s || s.indexOf('{{') === 0) return def;
      return s;
    }
    var items = [];
    for(var i = 1; i <= 6; i++){
      var name = v('g'+i+'_name', '');
      var price = parseFloat(v('g'+i+'_price', '0')) || 0;
      var icon = v('g'+i+'_icon', '');
      if(name && price > 0 && icon){ items.push({ id: 'g'+i, name: name, price: price, icon: icon }); }
    }
    if(items.length === 0){
      var defaults = [
        { id:'d1', name:'舒适抱枕', price:39.9, icon:'🛏️' },
        { id:'d2', name:'保温杯', price:59.9, icon:'☕' },
        { id:'d3', name:'蓝牙耳机', price:129, icon:'🎧' },
        { id:'d4', name:'可爱手机壳', price:19.9, icon:'📱' },
        { id:'d5', name:'零食大礼包', price:49.9, icon:'🍪' },
        { id:'d6', name:'桌面小风扇', price:79, icon:'🌀' }
      ];
      items.push.apply(items, defaults);
    }
    var extraDefaults = [
      { id:'ex1', name:'香薰蜡烛', price:29.9, icon:'🕯️' },
      { id:'ex2', name:'卡通拖鞋', price:25.9, icon:'👟' }
    ];
    var me = {
      name: v('me_name', '用户'),
      avatar: v('me_avatar', '🐱'),
      whisper: v('me_whisper', '今天也是元气满满的一天~')
    };
    return { items: items, extraDefaults: extraDefaults, me: me };
  }

  var appData = getData();
  var items = appData.items;
  var extraDefaults = appData.extraDefaults;

  var bargainedPrices = {};
  var cart = [];
  var cartTotal = 0;
  var blindboxUsed = false;
  var blindboxItemId = null;

  var LINK_KEYWORDS = {
    '项圈': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '颈圈': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '锁链': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '跳蛋': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' },
    '震动': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' },
    '按摩棒': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' },
    '手铐': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '束缚': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '绳子': { key: 'obedience', delta: 5, label: '服从+5' },
    '贞操锁': { key: 'shame', delta: 5, label: '羞耻+5' },
    '贞操带': { key: 'shame', delta: 5, label: '羞耻+5' },
    '蜡烛': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' },
    '低温': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' },
    '鞭子': { key: 'excitement', delta: 5, label: '兴奋+5' }
  };

  function detectLinkEffects(cartItems){
    var effects = {};
    cartItems.forEach(function(item){
      Object.keys(LINK_KEYWORDS).forEach(function(kw){
        if(item.name.indexOf(kw) !== -1){
          var eff = LINK_KEYWORDS[kw];
          if(!effects[eff.key]) effects[eff.key] = { delta: 0, labels: [] };
          effects[eff.key].delta += eff.delta;
          if(effects[eff.key].labels.indexOf(eff.label) === -1) effects[eff.key].labels.push(eff.label);
        }
      });
    });
    return effects;
  }

  function updateCartBadge(){
    var badge = document.getElementById('cartBadge');
    var count = cart.reduce(function(s, i){ return s + i.qty; }, 0);
    if(count > 0){
      badge.style.display = 'flex';
      badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : count;
      badge.classList.add('bump');
      setTimeout(function(){ badge.classList.remove('bump'); }, 300);
    } else { badge.style.display = 'none'; }
  }

  function renderCart(){
    var container = document.getElementById('cartContent');
    if(cart.length === 0){
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty"><span class="big">🛒</span>购物车是空的<br>去首页和抢购逛逛吧</div>';
      return;
    }
    var html = '<div class="cart-list">';
    var total = 0;
    cart.forEach(function(item, idx){
      var isFree = (blindboxItemId && item.id === blindboxItemId);
      var price = isFree ? 0 : (bargainedPrices[item.id] || item.price);
      var sub = price * item.qty;
      total += sub;
      var priceHTML = isFree ? '<div class="pr free">¥0.00 🎁免单</div>' : '<div class="pr">¥' + price.toFixed(2) + (bargainedPrices[item.id] ? ' 🔪已砍' : '') + '</div>';
      html += '<div class="cart-item">' +
        '<div class="img">' + esc(item.icon) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="info"><div class="nm">' + esc(item.name) + '</div>' + priceHTML + '</div>' +
        '<div class="qty-ctl">' +
          '<button data-cart-idx="' + idx + '" data-cart-delta="-1">−</button>' +
          '<span class="num">' + item.qty + '</span>' +
          '<button data-cart-idx="' + idx + '" data-cart-delta="1">+</button>' +
        '</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="cart-footer">' +
      '<div class="total">合计 <span class="pr">¥' + total.toFixed(2) + '</span></div>' +
      '<button class="btn-checkout" id="checkoutBtn">去结算</button></div>';
    container.innerHTML = html;
    cartTotal = total;

    container.querySelectorAll('.qty-ctl button').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var idx = parseInt(this.dataset.cartIdx, 10);
        var delta = parseInt(this.dataset.cartDelta, 10);
        cartQty(idx, delta);
      });
    });
    var checkoutBtn = document.getElementById('checkoutBtn');
    if(checkoutBtn){ checkoutBtn.addEventListener('click', checkout); }
  }

  function cartQty(idx, delta){
    if(!cart[idx]) return;
    cart[idx].qty += delta;
    if(cart[idx].qty <= 0) cart.splice(idx, 1);
    updateCartBadge();
    renderCart();
  }

  function addToCart(item){
    var isFree = (blindboxItemId && item.id === blindboxItemId);
    var price = isFree ? 0 : (bargainedPrices[item.id] || item.price);
    var addItem = { id: item.id, icon: item.icon, name: item.name, price: price, qty: 1, isFree: isFree };
    var exist = cart.find(function(i){ return i.id === item.id; });
    if(exist){ exist.qty += 1; }
    else { cart.push(addItem); }
    updateCartBadge();
    renderCart();
    switchTab('cart');
  }

  function checkout(){
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    var parts = [];
    var total = 0;
    cart.forEach(function(i){
      var isFree = (blindboxItemId && i.id === blindboxItemId);
      var price = isFree ? 0 : (bargainedPrices[i.id] || i.price);
      var label = isFree ? '🎁免单「' + i.name + '」' : '「' + i.name + '」';
      parts.push(label + '×' + i.qty);
      if(!isFree) total += price * i.qty;
    });

    var effects = detectLinkEffects(cart);
    var linkText = '';
    if(Object.keys(effects).length > 0){
      var labels = [];
      Object.keys(effects).forEach(function(k){
        labels.push.apply(labels, effects[k].labels);
      });
      linkText = '\n📊联动更新：' + labels.join(' ');
    }

    var msg = '（我在淘宝结算了购物车：' + parts.join('、') + '，一共 ¥' + total.toFixed(2) + '，坐等收货！' + linkText + '）';
    try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: msg }, '*'); } catch(e) {}

    var toast = document.getElementById('cartToast');
    toast.textContent = '✅ 结算成功！已下单';
    toast.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(function(){ toast.classList.remove('show'); }, 1200);

    cart = [];
    blindboxUsed = false;
    blindboxItemId = null;
    bargainedPrices = {};
    updateCartBadge();
    renderCart();
    resetBlindbox();
    resetAllBargainButtons();
    setTimeout(function(){ switchTab('home'); }, 600);
  }

  function toggleLike(btn, name){
    if(btn.classList.contains('liked')){
      btn.classList.remove('liked');
      btn.textContent = '🤍';
      return;
    }
    btn.classList.add('liked');
    btn.textContent = '❤️';
    try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: '（我在淘宝收藏了「' + name + '」✨）' }, '*'); } catch(e) {}
  }

  function doBargain(itemId, originalPrice, btnEl, priceEl){
    if(btnEl.classList.contains('done')) return;
    btnEl.classList.add('done');
    var rate = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    var newPrice = Math.round(originalPrice * rate * 10) / 10;
    bargainedPrices[itemId] = newPrice;
    if(priceEl){
      priceEl.textContent = '¥' + newPrice.toFixed(2);
      priceEl.classList.add('bargained');
    }
    var toast = document.getElementById('cartToast');
    toast.textContent = '🔪 砍价成功！¥' + originalPrice.toFixed(2) + ' → ¥' + newPrice.toFixed(2);
    toast.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(function(){ toast.classList.remove('show'); }, 1500);
  }

  function resetAllBargainButtons(){
    bargainedPrices = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.bargain-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('done'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.pr.bargained').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('bargained'); });
  }

  var flashItems = items.slice(0, 3);
  var guessItems = items.slice(0, 6);
  while(guessItems.length < 8){
    var ex = extraDefaults[guessItems.length - 6];
    if(ex) guessItems.push(ex);
    else break;
  }
  var grabItems = items.slice(0, 6);

  var flashHtml = '';
  flashItems.forEach(function(item){
    flashHtml += '<div class="flash-item" data-add-id="' + item.id + '" data-add-icon="' + esc(item.icon) + '" data-add-name="' + esc(item.name).replace(/'/g,"\\'") + '" data-add-price="' + item.price + '"><div class="img">' + esc(item.icon) + '</div><div class="nm">' + esc(item.name) + '</div><div class="pr">¥' + item.price.toFixed(2) + '<del>¥' + (item.price*1.6).toFixed(0) + '</del></div><span class="tag">抢</span></div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('flashScroll').innerHTML = flashHtml;
  document.querySelectorAll('#flashScroll .flash-item').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var item = { id: this.dataset.addId, icon: this.dataset.addIcon, name: this.dataset.addName, price: parseFloat(this.dataset.addPrice) };
      addToCart(item);
    });
  });

  var guessHtml = '';
  guessItems.forEach(function(item){
    guessHtml += '<div class="guess-card" data-add-id="' + item.id + '" data-add-icon="' + esc(item.icon) + '" data-add-name="' + esc(item.name).replace(/'/g,"\\'") + '" data-add-price="' + item.price + '">' +
      '<button class="bargain-btn" data-bargain-id="' + item.id + '" data-bargain-price="' + item.price + '">🔪</button>' +
      '<div class="img">' + esc(item.icon) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="info"><div class="nm">' + esc(item.name) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="bottom"><span class="pr" data-pr-id="' + item.id + '">¥' + item.price.toFixed(2) + '</span>' +
      '<button class="like-btn" data-like-name="' + esc(item.name).replace(/'/g,"\\'") + '">🤍</button></div></div></div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('guessGrid').innerHTML = guessHtml;

  document.querySelectorAll('#guessGrid .guess-card').forEach(function(card){
    card.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if(e.target.closest('.like-btn') || e.target.closest('.bargain-btn')) return;
      var item = { id: this.dataset.addId, icon: this.dataset.addIcon, name: this.dataset.addName, price: parseFloat(this.dataset.addPrice) };
      addToCart(item);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#guessGrid .like-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); toggleLike(this, this.dataset.likeName); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#guessGrid .bargain-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var itemId = this.dataset.bargainId;
      var origPrice = parseFloat(this.dataset.bargainPrice);
      var priceEl = document.querySelector('#guessGrid .pr[data-pr-id="' + itemId + '"]');
      doBargain(itemId, origPrice, this, priceEl);
    });
  });

  var grabHtml = '';
  grabItems.forEach(function(item){
    grabHtml += '<div class="flash-row">' +
      '<div class="img">' + esc(item.icon) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="info"><div class="nm">' + esc(item.name) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="pr" data-pr-id="' + item.id + '">¥' + item.price.toFixed(2) + '<del>¥' + (item.price*1.5).toFixed(0) + '</del></div>' +
      '<div class="hot">🔥 已抢 999+ 件</div></div>' +
      '<button class="bargain-btn" data-bargain-id="' + item.id + '" data-bargain-price="' + item.price + '">🔪</button>' +
      '<button class="btn-buy" data-grab-id="' + item.id + '" data-grab-icon="' + esc(item.icon) + '" data-grab-name="' + esc(item.name).replace(/'/g,"\\'") + '" data-grab-price="' + item.price + '">立即抢</button></div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('flashList').innerHTML = grabHtml;

  document.querySelectorAll('#flashList .btn-buy').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(this.classList.contains('done')) return;
      this.classList.add('done'); this.textContent = '✓ 已抢';
      var item = { id: this.dataset.grabId, icon: this.dataset.grabIcon, name: this.dataset.grabName, price: parseFloat(this.dataset.grabPrice) };
      addToCart(item);
      var self = this;
      setTimeout(function(){ self.classList.remove('done'); self.textContent = '立即抢'; }, 800);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#flashList .bargain-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var itemId = this.dataset.bargainId;
      var origPrice = parseFloat(this.dataset.bargainPrice);
      var priceEl = document.querySelector('#flashList .pr[data-pr-id="' + itemId + '"]');
      doBargain(itemId, origPrice, this, priceEl);
    });
  });

  function resetBlindbox(){
    blindboxUsed = false; blindboxItemId = null;
    var bbBtn = document.getElementById('bbBtn');
    bbBtn.textContent = '戳我抽免单'; bbBtn.classList.remove('done');
    document.getElementById('bbResult').textContent = '';
  }
  document.getElementById('bbBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(blindboxUsed) return;
    blindboxUsed = true;
    var idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * items.length);
    var chosen = items[idx];
    blindboxItemId = chosen.id;
    document.getElementById('bbResult').textContent = '🎉 恭喜！「' + chosen.name + '」免单！加入购物车0元带走~';
    this.textContent = '已抽过'; this.classList.add('done');
  });

  function getCharName(){
    var pokeEl = document.getElementById('pokePhrases');
    var p0 = pokeEl.dataset.p0 || '';
    // {{char}} 已被平台替换为真实角色名
    var match = p0.match(/告诉(.+?)你偷懒/);
    if(match && match[1] && match[1] !== '{{char}}') return match[1];
    // 兜底：从其他短语提取
    for(var i = 1; i < 8; i++){
      var p = pokeEl.dataset['p' + i] || '';
      var m2 = p.match(/(.+?)说/);
      if(m2 && m2[1] && m2[1] !== '{{char}}') return m2[1];
      var m3 = p.match(/告诉(.+?)你/);
      if(m3 && m3[1] && m3[1] !== '{{char}}') return m3[1];
      var m4 = p.match(/欠(.+?)一次/);
      if(m4 && m4[1] && m4[1] !== '{{char}}') return m4[1];
      var m5 = p.match(/(.+?)刚才/);
      if(m5 && m5[1] && m5[1] !== '{{char}}') return m5[1];
      var m6 = p.match(/(.+?)快来/);
      if(m6 && m6[1] && m6[1] !== '{{char}}') return m6[1];
    }
    return 'Char';
  }

  function buildTicker(){
    var fakeNames = ['春暖花开', '爷傲奈何我何', 'skrskr~', '家人们谁懂啊'];
    var fakeProducts = ['丝巾 🧣', '潮流T恤 👕', '蓝牙耳机 🎧', '零食大礼包 🍪'];
    var charName = getCharName();
    var charProduct = items[Math.floor(Math.random() * items.length)];
    var tickerItems = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < 4; i++){
      tickerItems.push({ name: fakeNames[i], product: fakeProducts[i], isChar: false });
    }
    tickerItems.push({ name: charName, product: charProduct.name + ' ' + charProduct.icon, isChar: true, charItem: charProduct });
    tickerItems.sort(function(){ return Math.random() - 0.5; });
    var html = '';
    for(var r = 0; r < 2; r++){
      tickerItems.forEach(function(ti){
        html += '<div class="ticker-item' + (ti.isChar ? ' char-item' : '') + '">' +
          '<span class="ticker-name">' + esc(ti.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="ticker-dot">刚刚购买了</span>' +
          '<span>' + esc(ti.product) + '</span>';
        if(ti.isChar){
          html += '<button class="ticker-share" data-char-name="' + esc(ti.name) + '" data-char-product="' + esc(ti.charItem.name) + '" data-char-price="' + ti.charItem.price + '">📤</button>';
        }
        html += '</div>';
      });
    }
    document.getElementById('tickerTrack').innerHTML = html;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ticker-share').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var cname = this.dataset.charName;
        var cproduct = this.dataset.charProduct;
        var cprice = this.dataset.charPrice;
        var msg = '（' + cname + '刚刚在淘宝购买了「' + cproduct + '」，花了 ¥' + parseFloat(cprice).toFixed(2) + '！\n我截图发给他：你居然偷偷买这个？）';
        try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: msg }, '*'); } catch(e) {}
      });
    });
  }

  var msgData = [
    { icon:'🏪', name:'天猫旗舰店', preview:'您收藏的商品降价了！', time:'10分钟前' },
    { icon:'📦', name:'菜鸟裹裹', preview:'您的包裹正在派送中', time:'30分钟前' },
    { icon:'💬', name: appData.me.name + '的专属客服', preview:'亲，有什么可以帮您的~', time:'1小时前' }
  ];
  var msgHtml = '';
  msgData.forEach(function(m){
    msgHtml += '<div class="msg-item" data-msg-name="' + esc(m.name) + '"><div class="av">' + esc(m.icon) + '</div><div class="info"><div class="nm">' + esc(m.name) + '</div><div class="prev">' + esc(m.preview) + '</div></div><div class="time">' + esc(m.time) + '</div></div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('msgList').innerHTML = msgHtml;
